Ο Κάρλο Νικοτιάν ίδρυσε τον μουσικό οίκο: Carlo Nikotian founded the music house in Athens in 1929. Almost a century later, the House is still a family business and the piano is still at its heart: we listen to it, we care for it and we introduce it to those who will play it.

Ο Κάρλο Νικοτιάν ήταν τεχνικός και χορδι: Carlo Nikotian was a piano technician and tuner. His work began with the ear: to listen to an instrument, understand what it needs and give it back its true voice.
Τον Μάρτιο του 1929 ίδρυσε τον μουσικό ο: In March 1929 he founded the music house at 63 Akadimias Street. His expertise in maintenance and tuning brought him close to the musicians of the time, and the House became associated with recitals by leading artists in Athens.
